title: 3hr Discover Sailing Adventure
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on a thrilling 3-hour introductory keelboat sailing experience designed for beginners eager to explore the basics of sailing. Guided by experienced instructors on our specially designed First 22 yacht, you’ll dive into essential sailing techniques, from mastering the art of sail trim to steering and navigation basics. This course emphasizes safety, preparation, and hands-on participation, allowing you to actively engage in raising and lowering sails, helming, and even docking. It’s the perfect opportunity to taste the freedom of the open water, learn valuable skills, and enjoy the camaraderie of sailing, all within a safe and supportive environment. Whether you’re looking to kickstart your sailing journey or simply spend a memorable day at sea, this experience promises a blend of education, adventure, and fun.
